decisions.reason: The mitred door lever handle family remained on the website across 2023 and 2024 and fits the firm's long-life, design-led architectural hardware portfolio, so removal within a year looks unlikely.
Its own dedicated page in 2024 suggests the multifunctional door lever handle has strategic importance for barrier-free and coordinated system solutions, supporting continued marketing and retention.

Although it appears to have a lower profile than the more prominently promoted ranges, it was still mentioned in 2024 and standard door lever variants usually remain in German specification-oriented portfolios for continuity.

This door and window handle collection has dedicated presentation and repeated design-award recognition, making it a strong brand and specification asset that the firm is very unlikely to withdraw soon.
